items.title: These AI Experts Want to Do High-Stakes Research Out in the Open
items.summary: Many frontier labs keep their risky research locked away. Trillium Labs wants to show off its work when it comes to self-improvement and model behavior.
items.author: Will Knight

items.title: Trump’s Crazy AI Rebrand Was a Loyalty Test for Tech Execs—and It Worked
items.summary: For years these billionaires gushed obsessively about AI. But they meekly went along when Trump canceled the term.
items.author: Steven Levy

items.title: A Flaw in ChatGPT’s Mac App Could Have Let Hackers Grab Sensitive Data
items.summary: While the focus has been on AI agents’ hacking capabilities, a recently patched vulnerability in a ChatGPT app shows that AI software is itself an inviting—and vulnerable—target.
items.author: Lily Hay Newman, Matt Burgess

items.title: AI Is Making a Mess of Nurses’ Schedules. They Say It’s a Safety Issue
items.summary: A hospital giant and radiology network turned to Palantir to streamline scheduling, but nurses and other staff say the new software is causing errors, burnout, and frustration.
items.author: Paresh Dave
